fullDescription:
Agerlas is a refined modern serif font designed to bring elegance, sophistication, and editorial character to contemporary designs. Featuring high contrast letterforms, graceful proportions, and distinctive serif details, Agerlas creates a luxurious visual presence while maintaining a clean and versatile appearance.

Perfect for fashion magazines, beauty branding, luxury logos, editorial layouts, perfume packaging, cosmetics, lifestyle brands, advertising, posters, invitations, and premium product designs. Its elegant character makes Agerlas especially suitable for headlines, brand names, magazine covers, and sophisticated visual identities.

Agerlas is a versatile choice for designers creating fashion campaigns, beauty identities, luxury packaging, editorial projects, product labels, social media graphics, wedding stationery, and premium branding materials. Its combination of classic serif elegance and modern proportions gives every composition a polished and timeless feel.
